title: Balance Beam Trail
shareTitle: Balance Beam Trail - A Papercraft Balance Adventure
description: Help Fern cross three playful papercraft trails with steady tilts, careful drags, and joyful hops.
learningGoals: Practice visual focus and movement sequencing
Develop wobble-positive confidence without time pressure
Coordinate directional control with a visible target
interactionModel: Choose one of three trails, then use device tilt, pointer drag, arrow keys, or five ordered taps to guide Fern through five checkpoints.
feedbackModel: Papercraft pose changes, a steady meter, stars, gentle coaching, soft sound effects, and a three-star celebration reward progress without failure states.
